rationale.A: Quiet Kallio/Vilhonvuori streets (Agricolankatu, Pengerkatu, Suvilahdenkatu); only 60 m on Helsinginkatu (tram); 5 lights
rationale.B: Same start as A, then the path beside Lautatarhankatu; 60 m on Helsinginkatu; 5 lights
rationale.C: Paths beside Sörnäisten rantatie (50 km/h), then 290 m in traffic on Koksikatu/Hermannin rantatie; 3 lights; +0 min
rationale.D: Same as C, with an unsignalised Porthaninkatu crossing
rationale.E: Same as C, on paths instead of the open area
rationale.F: Same as C, short jog via Kaikukatu; 4 lights
rationale.G: No mixed traffic at all: Pengerkatu, Kinaporinkatu, paths, Työpajankatu; 3 lights; one unsignalised Lautatarhankatu crossing
rationale.H: ~420 m in traffic on Helsinginkatu (370 m with tram rails); 6 lights

notes: C saves 2 lights at no extra time. G is the calmest (+1 min, also 3 lights), but A is already a quiet-street route, so G is not a clear calm tier gain.
